name: Erica
source:
MBTI: ESFP

"It's meant to mean you either get with us, or you get the hell out of our way... Don't put yourself on a pedestal, mate. We can solve this with or without you, got it?"

The clever delinquent who carries her own sense of justice. Quick to assert her own beliefs, Erica is someone who makes it apparent she isn't here to take anyone else's nonsense. Claiming her last memory is being lost in a stuffy crowd, she can't seem to recall why they might be in this situation. However, in making sure no one is trying to compromise the legitimacy of the group's knowledge, Erica doesn't intend to let liars off the hook easily.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
